messages:
Maya: Quick sync — dropped a prototype for a compact capacity control. Key changes: explicit 'states' (Idle / Ready / Scaling), a small live cost preview (per-hour default), and a tiny burst ramp mini-chart. Screenshot: https://files.redwood/prototypes/compact-capacity.png
Devon: Looks useful. Can we keep the min/max numeric inputs visible when the control is focused? In the mock they fade out which makes precision editing awkward.
Liam: Heads up — the live cost calc assumes fractional GPU support. If fractional GPUs aren't available at the API layer we'll need to round and show a note. Otherwise we can show tokens/sec or concurrency estimates instead.
Maya: Good point. UX decision: show the precise cost estimate but add a small ‘‘rounded to nearest supported unit’’ hint if fractional support is off.
Sasha: Accessibility nits: the burst badge color contrast falls below AA at small sizes. Also, the slider handles need aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax/aria-valuenow and an aria-label that includes units. When the burst toggle changes state we should fire a live region announcement.
Devon: Microcopy suggestion: rename the inline label 'burst' to 'burst capacity' — less vague. Tooltip: 'Burst capacity provides short-term additional GPUs; duration and cooldown apply.'
Liam: Implementation detail: if we allow quarter-GPU steps (0.25), routing needs to know how to map fractional allocations to whole-device tasks. We should define a rounding policy in the API contract and surface it in the UI. Also: how do SLO guardrails interact with burst? If burst increases latency for other pools we should auto-fallback.
Maya: Proposal: when burst is enabled show a non-modal guardrail banner: 'Burst may affect other pools — enable automatic routing fallback?' with primary CTA 'Enable fallback' and a small 'Learn more' link to docs.
Sasha: For SR users: when burst toggles on announce: 'Burst capacity enabled: +{X} GPUs for up to {Y} minutes.' Also ensure the guardrail banner is focusable and keyboard-trappable.
OpsBot: deploybot: Prototype pushed to staging: https://staging.redwood/ui/compact-capacity (build 5172) :rocket:
Devon: UI polish: make the live cost preview default to 'per-hour' but allow a per-minute toggle. Label as 'Estimated cost' and show base rate with an info tooltip.
Liam: I'll add an API flag 'enable_fractional_gpus' on the server side for a staged rollout. If false we'll display the estimate and a disabled badge with the rounding explanation.
Maya: Next steps: Devon update Figma with visible numeric inputs + new label, Sasha to write the SR aria copy and color contrast tweaks, Liam to wire the API flag and rounding policy, Ops to validate staging build. Quick follow-up tomorrow 10:00am PT. :thumbsup:
